title: Algerian Kid-Friendly Pastry
description: Delicious pastry filled with meat and spices, perfect for kids. A classic Algerian dish that is easy to make and fun to eat.
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F. In a large mixing bowl, combine flour, warm water, and olive oil to make the pastry dough.
Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes until smooth. Place in a greased bowl, cover with a damp cloth, and let rest for 30 minutes.
In a large skillet, heat 2 tablespoons of olive oil over medium heat. Add chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add ground beef to the skillet, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks. Cook until browned, about 5-7 minutes.
Add salt, black pepper, and cumin to the skillet and stir to combine. Cook for 1 minute.
Roll out the pastry dough to a thickness of about 1/8 inch. Cut into rectangles, about 6x4 inches.
Spoon the meat mixture onto one half of each rectangle, leaving a 1/2 inch border around the edges.
Fold the other half of the pastry over the filling, pressing edges to seal.
Brush tops of pastry with olive oil and place on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake in preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley.
Cook ground beef to an internal temperature of 71°C / 160°F (no longer pink in the middle) before serving.
